en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large, three-story urban villa or apartment building with dormer windows and ornate arched window decorations. A central balcony and covered entrance face the street, with bare trees and a low wall with gate in the foreground. The lower half of the card is blank for writing, and there is printed cursive text at the bottom indicating an address.
